About this item

  • Get the full picture with 180º field of view plus auto pan and zoom, and see clearly with true 1080p image quality, day or night.
  • Feel more secure with motion and person detection notifications, can tell when a person enters the frame and will only send you reliable notifications.
  • Learn what really happened with 30-day video history. ecobee Smart Security Subscription required.
  • Your privacy matters, the SmartCamera can shut off automatically when family members arrive and features on-device processing and end-to-end encryption.
  • Smoke Alarm Detection keeps your whole family safe. Get an alert on your phone if SmartCamera detects sound from your smoke alarm.
  • Works in harmony with Amazon Alexa and Apple HomeKit.
  • Two-Way Talk, check in and say hello from your phone to your home, loud and clear, thanks to SmartCamera’s built-in far-field speakers.
  • Alexa Built-in for hands-free use, control SmartCamera with your voice or from your phone and get access to all of Alexa’s features innately.
  • Get 1 month of home monitoring when you purchase a SmartCamera. Protect your home with ecobee Smart Security. Trial starts when you register your device.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      Reviewed in Canada on 19 October 2025
      Style Name: Smart Camera

      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I’m really happy with this camera so far. The setup through Apple Home was smooth, and it integrates perfectly with my other HomeKit devices. I can easily check the live feed directly from the Home app or even ask Siri to show me the camera. The video quality is crisp, with a wide 180° field of view that captures the entire room.

      The night vision is clear, and I love the two-way audio — it’s great for checking in at home when I’m away. The motion and person detection work accurately, and the notifications arrive almost instantly. I also appreciate that Ecobee takes privacy seriously, allowing local video encryption and automatic pausing when family members are detected.

      The only small downside is that it requires a steady Wi-Fi connection; if your signal is weak, it can occasionally disconnect. Other than that, it’s been very reliable.

      Overall, this is a great choice for Apple Home users who want a camera that’s simple to use, secure, and smartly designed.

      I bought the Ecobee indoor smart camera along with the Ecobee Smart Doorbell Camera before leaving on vacation, and it’s been a fantastic addition to my home security setup. This camera allowed me to monitor multiple entry points in real-time while we were away, giving us total peace of mind.

      Reliable Monitoring for Every Entry Point:

      Setting up the camera was quick and straightforward, and I positioned it to cover a key entry point in the house. During our trip, the camera’s live feed and instant alerts let me check in anytime, providing an extra layer of security beyond just the doorbell camera. The clarity of the video feed was excellent, both day and night, and I could rely on it to see exactly what was happening at home.

      Great for Future Use:

      Now that we’re back, the camera is still proving invaluable. It seamlessly integrates with the Ecobee ecosystem, meaning I get alerts directly on my thermostat and other devices. I can also use it to check on our home in real-time, which is perfect for keeping an eye on things when I’m out. The fact that it doubles as a chime for the doorbell camera is an added bonus, making sure we’re alerted to any movement at the front door as well.

      Overall:

      Whether you’re going on vacation or just want to keep your home secure day-to-day, this Ecobee indoor smart camera is an outstanding investment. It’s reliable, easy to use, and gives you peace of mind, both when you’re home and away. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enhance their home security!

      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

      I have been using this camera for a while now and it’s been great. Unfortunately I had it sitting on top of a piece of furniture and I accidentally knocked it over. It only fell about a foot but it landed on my hard tile floor just right and the whole front which is glass cracked badly. So I went back on Amazon to purchase a replacement and saw it was on sale so I bought two. I always wanted one in my garage so now I do. Very easy to set up.

      Great picture quality and the speaker is damn good for as small as it is. I love that when I added these cameras they were automatically added to my Alexa Echo spot. I only complaint is at this date in time ecobee does not make an outdoor camera.

      I also own the ecobee thermostat and the ecobee doorbell camera, love everything ecobee so far.

      I also like that you do not need to load a micro sd card into the camera.

      One note if you want to use more than one camera you will have to pay a yearly subscription of $90

      That will allow you to add as many cameras as you like. With that yearly subscription you will also be able to have ecobee monitor your home as a security system. I have ordered the ecobee window and door sensors and they will be installed tomorrow. So I feel $90 year for a home security system is pretty inexpensive. Well worth the money in my opinion.
